Glyphs are consumables that can be used for augmenting the crafting process.

## Mechanics[]

Glyphs are a crafting item that can be used in the support item slot on the crafting panel along with an affix shard. They modify the circumstances of crafting, either by granting more crafting opportunities, or preserving certain aspects of an item. The slotted glyph is consumed after an affix is crafted.

Like Runes, they can drop from random enemies and containers, or they are awarded from certain echoes in the Monolith of Fate.

## List of Glyphs[]

| Name | Effect on Use |

| Glyph of Hope | Forging Potential is not consumed for the craft (25% chance). |

| Glyph of Chaos | The upgraded affix is replaced with another one (respecting prefix/suffix slot). |

| Glyph of Order | The roll of the upgraded affix is preserved in its range (i.e. a high roll remains high in the next tier). |

| Glyph of Despair | The affix is sealed instead of being upgraded, freeing up its slot (random chance). |

| Glyph of Insight | The affix is converted to an Experimental Affix. |

| Glyph of Envy | The item is destabilized, re-rolling other affixes and increasing Stability in the last visited timeline. |
